title: Short-Term Forecasting of Heterogeneous Wind Power Fleets: Global Temporal Fusion Transformer Leveraging Static Covariates
abstract: arXiv:2611.06130v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Accurate short-term wind power forecasting is critical for grid stability and electricity trading. While transformer-based deep learning is state of the art, industry practice relies mostly on local models trained for individual assets. This study investigates whether a global temporal fusion transformer (TFT), trained jointly on a heterogeneous portfolio of wind farms across Germany, outperforms site-specific local models in 48-hour-ahead forecasting. Using numerical weather prediction (NWP) data from the regional ICON-D2 and the global ECMWF HRES models, we compare the global TFT against local models and a linear regression baseline. The global model leverages static covariates, such as farm age, altitude above sea level, hub height, rotor diameter and power curve parameters, to learn shared representations across sites. translated_title: 异构风电场的短期功率预测：利用静态协变量的全局时间融合Transformer
translated_abstract: 精确的短期风电功率预测对电网稳定性和电力交易至关重要。尽管基于Transformer的深度学习是当前最先进的技术，但行业实践主要依赖针对单个资产训练的局部模型。本研究探讨在德国多个异构风电场组合上联合训练的全局时间融合Transformer（TFT），在48小时前瞻预测中是否优于针对特定站点的局部模型。研究使用来自区域ICON-D2模式和全球ECMWF HRES模式的数值天气预报（NWP）数据，将全局TFT与局部模型及线性回归基线进行比较。全局模型利用静态协变量（如风电场场龄、海拔高度、轮毂高度、转子直径和功率曲线参数）来学习跨站点的共享表示。研究在100个合成风电场剖面和由11个德国真实风电场组成的组合上进行评估，并跨越两个季节进行测试。
tldr: 本研究提出一种利用静态协变量（场龄、海拔、轮毂高度、转子直径和功率曲线参数等）在异构风电场组合上联合训练的全局时间融合Transformer（TFT），并证明其在48小时前瞻风电功率预测中优于针对单个站点训练的局部模型。
en_tdlr: This study proposes a global Temporal Fusion Transformer (TFT) trained jointly on heterogeneous wind farm portfolios by leveraging static covariates (e.g., farm age, altitude, hub height, rotor diameter, and power curve parameters), demonstrating superior 48-hour-ahead wind power forecasting performance over site-specific local models.
